A.why: Enrollment does fall from 2017 to 2018, but only by 20. You stopped at the first decrease you saw and didn't compare it with the later drops of 40 and 80.

B.why: From 2018 to 2019 the line has its steepest rise, up 80. That's the biggest increase, and the question asks for a decrease.

C.why: The drop from 2019 to 2020 starts at the highest point on the graph, 260. Even so, enrollment falls only 40 there. You focused on the highest value instead of the size of the change.

stem: According to the line graph, during which of the following 2-minute intervals did the runner's heart rate change by the greatest amount?
stimulus: A sports science lab measured a runner's heart rate, in beats per minute, every 2 minutes during a 12-minute interval workout. The measurements are shown in the line graph.

figure.caption: Heart Rate During an Interval Workout
figure.alt: Line graph of heart rate in beats per minute by time in minutes: 0, 100; 2, 130; 4, 85; 6, 115; 8, 155; 10, 160; 12, 140.

explanation: "Change" counts both rises and falls, so compare the size of each change. From 2 to 4 minutes the heart rate falls from 130 to 85, a change of 45 beats per minute. From 6 to 8 it rises by 40, from 8 to 10 it rises by 5, and from 10 to 12 it falls by 20. The greatest change is 45 beats per minute, from 2 to 4 minutes.

B.why: A rise of 40 beats per minute is the greatest increase, but the question asks about change in either direction. The fall of 45 from 2 to 4 minutes is bigger.

C.why: This interval ends at the highest heart rate on the graph, 160, but it changes by only 5. You picked the highest point instead of the biggest change.

D.why: This interval falls from the peak, but only by 20 beats per minute. Where a segment starts doesn't tell you how much it changes.

stem: According to the line graph, in which year was the number of pottery fragments recovered 20 fewer than the number recovered the year before?
stimulus: An archaeological team excavating a hillside settlement recorded the number of pottery fragments it recovered each field season from 2015 to 2021. The counts are shown in the line graph.

figure.caption: Pottery Fragments Recovered per Field Season
figure.alt: Line graph of pottery fragments recovered by year: 2015, 50; 2016, 70; 2017, 65; 2018, 80; 2019, 60; 2020, 65; 2021, 55.

explanation: Check each choice against the year before it. In 2019 the team recovered 60 fragments, and in 2018 it recovered 80. That is 20 fewer. No other choice falls by 20 from the previous year, so the answer is 2019.

A.why: The 2016 count is 70, which is 20 more than the 50 recovered in 2015. You found a change of the right size in the wrong direction.

B.why: The count does fall in 2017, but only from 70 to 65, which is 5 fewer. It's a decrease, but not a decrease of 20.

C.why: 2018 is the year before the drop. The question asks for the year whose count was 20 fewer, which is 2019, the year after.
